descriptions.job-0aji6ex:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

As part of the Bybit Fiat team, we are looking for a P2P Regional Operations Manager to own regional growth strategy and day-to-day operational performance in Africa. You will lead a small team of regional Business Development specialists, partner closely with local teams on the ground, and serve as the regional growth engine to accommodate global P2P strategy, develop localised strategy and turn the strategy into execution.
 
Reporting to the Global P2P Operations & COE Lead, you will be accountable for P2P regional growth target, merchant ecosystem development, regional product rollouts, and cross-functional coordination across Product, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Community, and Customer Service. This is a regional team leader role for someone who is equally comfortable in strategy thinking and solid market-level execution.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Operational Ownership

• Own day-to-day P2P business performance across Africa markets and other assigned regions.
• Monitor regional OKR including transaction volume, competitiveness, disputes, and fraud patterns, etc.
• Identify operational bottlenecks and propose data-driven solutions to improve platform efficiency and user experience.
• Provide localised business insights to the P2P Ops Lead, own regional strategy and contribute to product roadmap.

Team Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a small team of regional Business Development managers covering target markets.
• Set clear targets, structured workflows, and review cadences for the BD team.
• Identify capability gaps and actively drive upskilling, hiring, and team development.
• Foster a performance-driven, collaborative, and ownership-led culture.

Merchant Ecosystem Development

• Drive merchant onboarding, relationship management, performance tracking, incentive programs, and quality improvements across the region.
• Oversee and grow merchant community to maintain a healthy, active, and engaged P2P ecosystem.
• Serve as the primary liaison between Bybit and the regional merchant community.

Cross-functional & Local Coordination

• Coordinate with local market teams to align operations with country-specific dynamics, regulations, and user behavior.
• Work with Product to communicate regional needs, test new P2P features, and support local rollout.
• Work with Risk and Compliance to ensure safe P2P operations (fraud prevention) and adherence to local regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with Marketing and Community on regional campaigns and user education.
• Coordinate with Customer Service to support dispute resolution and ensure efficient handling of user cases.
• Execute and continuously contribute operational SOPs, working with P2P COE.

Market Insights & Growth

• Analyze regional P2P market trends, pricing dynamics, payment methods, and competitive landscape.
• Surface insights from market research and merchant feedback to Product, Risk, Compliance, and CS, working with COE
• Lead regional P2P go-to-market initiatives and growth campaigns in partnership with Marketing.
• Drive execution of user acquisition initiatives and campaign rollouts

What We're Looking For

Must Have

• 5+ years of relevant experience in operations, business development, or product operations — ideally in crypto, fintech, tech., marketplaces, or adjacent sectors.
• 2+ years of proven experience leading or coordinating small teams.
• Hands-on experience operating across multiple countries or markets.
• Strong understanding of operational workflows, project management best practices, and structured execution.
• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
• Strategic thinking and analytical mindset: comfortable with dashboards, data-driven decision-making, and translating numbers into strategy and actions.
• Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a strong plus.
• Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving environment.

Nice to Have

• Direct experience with P2P platforms, crypto exchanges, or digital asset ecosystems.
• Familiarity with merchant management in a marketplace or P2P environment.
• Exposure to risk monitoring, anti-fraud methods, KYC/KYB processes, or transaction oversight.
• Experience with growth campaigns, user acquisition, or market launches.
• Passion for blockchain, financial inclusion, and the future of decentralized finance.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-1fccvuh:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

 

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

  • Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

  • Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

  • Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

  • A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

  • Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

  • A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

  • A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Learn on the Kraken Blog

Connect on LinkedIn

descriptions.job-0k0169l:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

About The Team

At Fireblocks, the DevOps group is responsible for the core infrastructure and enablement for developers. 

The group consists of 15 engineers, working together to provide standards, abilities and support to RND.

The group manages the various Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts and deployment pipelines to name a few.

We’re looking for a DevOps Team Leader to join the group, lead the team’s projects and manage several engineers (technically and professionally) to bring upon new capabilities, improvements and to ensure we’re on the frontline of the industry's standards.

In this role, you will

  • Manage a team of DevOps engineers.
  • Manage the team’s projects and tasks.
  • Take a major role in the design, building, and operational management of a highly secure and scalable platform.
  • Promote, document, and implement systems infrastructure best practices.
  • Play a mentorship role to team members, constantly promoting improvement in their professional skills.
  • Provide self-service capabilities in order to empower the business’s software engineering teams.
  • Define tasks aimed at reducing/eliminating any repetitive or manual tasks and assist with prioritization.
  • Work with other infra teams on improving health and performance issues of the system.
  • Play a strategic role in designing and building infrastructure for ensuring the highest levels of security and responding swiftly to any new and emerging vulnerabilities and security threats.
  • Actively hands-on on projects and tasks.

What will you bring to the role?

  • At least 4 years experience leading a DevOps team.
  • At least 5 years of working experience in a DevOps capacity, working within a fast-paced and fast-evolving SaaS environment.
  • At least 5 years of experience with cloud providers - AWS/Azure.
  • At least 10 years of experience in high-tech companies in DevOps roles or similar positions (such as software engineer, system administrator, automation engineer etc)

  • Experience with GitOps methodology and supporting tools.
  • Experience with GitLab Pipelines.
  • AI based mindset - creation of agents and skills to reduce constant workload.
  • Strong system-level troubleshooting skills and ability to identify and resolve high-level scalability, performance issues and complex problems.
  • Strong communication skills in a highly collaborative environment.

Advantages:

  • BSC in Computer Science or related technical certificate.
  • Background in software development.
  • FinOps experience.

Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

descriptions.job-0i7k6k9:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

As a Senior HR Technology Analyst, you will be a hybrid functional and technical subject matter specialist on the HR Technology team—pairing hands-on Workday configuration with strong reporting and analytics skills. You will administer and configure DRW's global HR system, Workday, while also partnering with our HR Reporting Analyst as a responsible owner of scheduled and ad hoc reporting needs across Workday, business intelligence tools, and emerging AI-enabled analytics. You will partner closely with HR and business stakeholders on system support, survey programs, and a variety of business-facing projects that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.

Core Duties:

HR Technology & Workday Configuration

  • Administer and configure Workday HCM across modules such as Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Time Tracking, Absence, Compensation, Performance, and Talent, including troubleshooting, processing changes, business process configuration, security maintenance, integration monitoring, EIB creation and loading, and functional testing
  • Provide senior-level functional support for end users, diagnosing issues, identifying root causes, and delivering durable solutions
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into Workday configuration, and deliver scalable process improvements that support DRW's growth and employee experience
  • Support Workday's semi-annual system upgrades, including release note review, design recommendations, configuration, and user acceptance testing
  • Develop user guides, system documentation, and training materials; assist with Workday training as needed
  • Maintain HRIS data integrity through audits, analysis, and ongoing data quality practices
  • Serve as a backup for Workday permissions, security administration, and related system governance
  • Remain current on HR technology and data strategies, including opportunities to leverage Workday, integrations, BI, and AI tools for operational effectiveness

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the HR Reporting Analyst as a responsible owner of Workday reporting, calculated fields, dashboards, and related analytics
  • Own and execute regular scheduled reporting, and support ad hoc reporting requests for HR and business stakeholders
  • Build, maintain, and improve reports and dashboards in Workday; support reporting needs in adjacent systems (for example, Greenhouse) as needed
  • Use business intelligence tools and AI-enabled analytics tools to extract, analyze, and present workforce insights that support decision-making
  • Help maintain the catalog of reports, dashboards, and analytics assets, ensuring accuracy, documentation, and timely delivery
  • Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, manage expectations, and continuously improve reporting structure and data quality

Survey Support & Business-Facing Projects

  • Support engagement, pulse, and other business survey programs end to end—including setup, administration, reporting, and stakeholder follow-up as needed
  • Partner with HR and business leaders on survey design, distribution, results packaging, and related action-planning support
  • Lead or contribute to miscellaneous business-facing HR Technology projects, balancing configuration work, reporting deliverables, and stakeholder communication
  • Support broader HR Operations and HR Technology initiatives as needed, bringing both systems and analytics perspectives to project work

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5–7+ years of progressive HRIS / HR Technology experience, with substantial hands-on Workday functional configuration experience in one or more of: HCM, Compensation, Payroll, Benefits, Talent, Time Tracking, Absence Management, Security, and Reporting
  • Demonstrated Workday configuration and implementation experience, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and deliver production-ready solutions
  • Strong Workday reporting experience, including designing, building, testing, and maintaining custom reports, calculated fields, and dashboards
  • Experience owning scheduled reporting cycles and partnering on reporting deliverables in a deadline-driven environment
  • Proficiency with business intelligence / analytics tools (for example, Tableau, Power BI, or similar); comfort exploring and applying AI tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and insight generation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools thoughtfully and effectively for analysis, reporting support, documentation, and problem-solving, with good judgment about when AI adds value and when human review is required
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including extracting, manipulating, and validating data to produce accurate, actionable outputs
  • Experience supporting survey programs (engagement, pulse, or other business surveys) preferred
  • Strong understanding of HR business processes and operational analysis across areas such as payroll, benefits, compensation, recruiting, talent, and performance management
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer service skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical partners
  • Strong organization, prioritization, and project management skills, with proven ability to balance concurrent configuration, reporting, and project work
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and experience handling highly confidential information with discretion
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, adapt to changing priorities, and collaborate broadly across the organization

Who we are:

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As a SMB Hunter Sales Manager at Stripe, you will play an instrumental role in fueling Stripe’s growth through new customer acquisition. In this role, you will build and lead a team of high-performing Account Executives, helping them to develop their skills and deliver on their ambitious targets, as well as roll your sleeves up to work directly with customers. We are looking for a proactive leader who has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity, operating in a high-growth environment, managing high-performing teams and solving complicated problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have management and leadership experience scaling a technology sales team and possess first-class analytical, communication and relationship-building skills.

You will: 

  • Recruit, develop and lead a team of Account Executives who focus on small and medium, high-growth, tech-forward businesses 
  • Work with senior leadership to develop the long-term vision and strategy for the team, and manage day-to-day operations with a focus on performance against key sales and growth metrics
  • Be accountable for increasing revenue and new client acquisition at high rates of growth
  • Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills
  • Inspire, motivate and enable development of team members to promote career growth and impact for Stripe 
  • Work collaboratively and cross-functionally across the organization to help shape Stripe’s products and solutions to meet customer needs
  • Play a personal and direct role in building and maintaining enduring customer relationships, up to C-level.
  • Implement programs to improve pipeline generation efforts and improve overall efficiency for the team

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, with 2+ years of people management experience preferred 
  • Experience leading sales in an early stage, high-growth technology environment
  • Ability to hire, train and coach a high-performance sales team
  • Ability to build relationships with strategic client and industry thought leaders
  • Demonstrated passion for start-ups and new technology businesses
  • Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts, and translate them into industry- or business-relevant terms

Nice to haves:

  • Prior experience at a growth stage internet/software company
  • Prior experience forecasting and managing a high growth commercial business
  • Prior experience running complex sales cycles, ideally with both commercial and enterprise size companies
  • Prior experience leading a team in an office outside of the company headquarters
  • Prior experience in the payments industry and/or fintech

descriptions.job-0t57yt5:
WHO WE ARE

Baton Corporation builds and maintains pump.fun — the dominant memecoin launchpad, processing $300M+ in daily volume. Last year, pump.fun generated over $500M in profit with a team of fewer than 100 people.

We ship to production daily. Bureaucracy is minimal. We solve hard technical and go-to-market problems at scale, and we're data-driven — systematic tools and the scientific method decide what works, not opinions.

Working with us isn't for everyone. We work in person. Hours are long and sometimes strange. The pace is intense. Individuals own their function end to end. When we ship a change, it reaches hundreds of thousands of users within days.

 

THE ROLE

We're making a founding hire: a Staff Data Scientist in Marketing Science to own the mathematics behind our paid growth - the causal measurement, the response curves, the customer-value models and the optimisation that decide where our multi-million-dollar, always-on acquisition budget goes across Google, Apple Search Ads, OpenAI ads, Meta, TikTok and X. There is no inherited methodology - you design it from first principles.

Your job is to answer one question, continuously and with evidence: where should the next $1 million go to generate the most additional profit - and how confident are we?

This is a hands-on, builder role. You'll write the models yourself, design the experiments that keep them honest, and sit next to the people moving the budget. Our data engineers own the pipelines; you own the science.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build our marketing measurement system - a Bayesian marketing mix model with adstock and saturation, channel-level response curves and full uncertainty, in PyMC, Stan, NumPyro, Meridian or a framework you can defend
  • Separate attributed from incremental - design and analyse geo-experiments, conversion-lift tests, holdouts and synthetic-control studies, and use the results to calibrate the model
  • Turn models into budget decisions - estimate marginal ROAS and marginal CAC by channel, run constrained budget optimisation and give the paid acquisition team a clear, risk-aware allocation every planning cycle
  • Model what a user is worth - build LTV, retention and payback models tied to activation and trading activity, so we optimise for profit, not platform-reported ROAS
  • Measure what the platforms can't - build defensible approaches for newer or opaque channels (OpenAI ads, X, Apple Search Ads, crypto-native networks) where lift tooling is thin or missing
  • Work alongside the Head of Paid Acquisition & Performance Marketing to set test roadmaps, define success metrics and decide what to scale and what to stop
  • Ship production-quality code - versioned, tested and reproducible - and partner with Data Engineering on the inputs the models need
  • Explain uncertainty plainly - write decision memos that founders and operators can act on, including when the right answer is "we don't know yet - here's the test"

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Advanced quantitative training - a PhD, MSc or equivalent depth in mathematics, statistics, econometrics, physics or operations research. What matters is that you can derive it, not just run it
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience (PhD research counts), with a track record building marketing mix or advertising response models that moved real budgets - in-house at a consumer, fintech or app business, or at a measurement company (Recast, Haus, PyMC Labs, Google, Meta or similar) - with results you can explain and evidence
  • Hands-on causal inference - you have designed, run and analysed incrementality experiments, and you know what to do when the experiment and the model disagree• Deep Bayesian modelling - hierarchical models, priors you can justify, identification, posterior diagnostics and the computational know-how to make them fit at speed
  • Strong Python or R in production - you write the model code yourself
  • Commercial judgment - you think natively in incremental profit, LTV, CAC and payback, and you can turn a posterior into a recommendation a non-specialist will act on
  • A scrappy, high-energy operator mindset - you thrive in a fast-paced, resource-lean environment where you're building the playbook as you go

NICE TO HAVE

  • Contributions to open-source measurement tools - PyMC-Marketing, Meridian, Robyn, LightweightMMM, CausalPy, Stan, GeoLift or similar
  • Mobile app user acquisition - SKAdNetwork, AppsFlyer or Adjust, and Apple Search Ads
  • Crypto experience - as a retail trader, or through work at a crypto startup or larger crypto company

Sophisticated equations matter. Better allocation decisions matter more.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

  • First 30 days: Current measurement audited, a baseline response model live for core channels, and the first incrementality tests designed with the paid acquisition team
  • First 90 days: An experiment-calibrated model producing channel response curves, marginal returns and a recommended allocation with confidence ranges, used in the budget cycle
  • First 180 days: Budget reallocations driven by the model delivering measurable incremental profit, with an always-on test-and-learn programme across existing and new channels

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Base salary: $300,000 - $400,000, depending on experience and scope
  • Performance-related compensation: Generous performance bonus; token participation depending on level
  • Benefits and relocation support: To be confirmed for this role

LOCATION & ELIGIBILITY

  • New York preferred, working in person with our growth team. For exceptional candidates we will consider remote work with strong overlap with US Eastern hours and regular time in New York.
  • For New York-based roles you must be authorized to work in the United States. Please tell us in your application whether you will now or in the future require visa sponsorship.

HOW TO APPLY

descriptions.job-1du1309:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startup SaaS Platform team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. At Stripe, SaaS platforms are companies using Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their own product, meaning their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their business, like Shopify, Mindbody and Lightspeed.

SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team identifies and develops Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We identify and partner with high-potential companies, helping them leverage Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally and create new revenue streams through monetisation of payments and financial services. 

What you’ll do

As a Hunter Account Executive on the Startup SaaS Platforms team, you will be instrumental in driving Stripe’s future growth. 

The role will involve prospecting to businesses, articulating the value of Stripe and strategically advising them on how they can optimize their business using Stripe solutions, either for the first time or by expanding their use of Stripe. We guide our users to understand how Stripe’s modern financial infrastructure can support their growth ambitions and provide a competitive edge for their business or product.

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and cultivate a named account list (New Prospects)) while crafting comprehensive account plans aimed at winning and expanding business with high growth Startups.
  • Understand users' pain points and our value to SaaS platform clients, proposing tailored solutions that consult on their long-term growth.
  • Bring clients through complex evaluations of Stripe’s solutions for SaaS platforms, working with cross-functional teams (Product, Risk, Operations) to successfully follow new projects through to activation and adoption.
  • Foster relationships with executive stakeholders and represent Stripe in the local startup ecosystem to help us grow our footprint and mindshare.
  • Work with other cross-functional teams on shared initiatives to drive internal efficiency and broader business impact.
  • Own the complete sales cycle, from lead generation through to product adoption within the target Startup segment.
  • Develop robust outbound strategies and execute creative prospecting programmes to create and nurture new business opportunities and contribute directly to our GTM priority of driving new logos and accelerating revenue realisation.
  • Identify high-potential prospective startups from inbound leads and dedicated outbound prospecting, collaborating closely with Marketing and Sales Development teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for a curious, well-rounded strategic seller who can build strong relationships with Stripe’s clients in this key segment. You are comfortable owning your territory, balancing a mix of high value, strategic deals with smaller, high velocity deal cycles.

You are solution-oriented, adaptable, have a keen interest in further developing yourself and know how to get things done. You do enjoy a highly-technical sales cycle and working with a diverse group of internal stakeholders.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a client-facing/closing sales role
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems
  • Desire to build great relationships, often with technical customers
  • Analytical ability to manage complex sales cycles
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • Bias towards team success and knowledge sharing
  • A knack for seeking out and working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fluid environment
  • High professional fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a Plus)

Preferred requirements

  • Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth technology company
  • Comfort interpreting and discussing API-first solutions
descriptions.job-1nvr4l5:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Testability has long been a priority for Stripe. Before users trust code with their money, they need to verify that it’s safe and correct. This need drove Stripe to build test mode and, more recently, Sandboxes, which enables safe, isolated, and scalable testing.

As businesses build with AI and agents, their testing needs are evolving. Stripe customers use claimable sandboxes to add Stripe capabilities to prototypes before business registration. Once onboarded, they provision isolated test environments to support agents’ exploration. These capabilities help developers and agents build and test their integrations with Stripe.

The Sandboxes team defines, builds, and operates these testing capabilities. We work across Stripe to make our products testable, helping businesses develop with confidence and shaping the future of Stripe’s developer platform.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead and grow the Sandboxes engineering team, setting technical direction and operating critical systems. You’ll build a culture of operational excellence and thoughtful product development.

You’ll work directly with users to understand their needs and partner with Product, Design, and Data Science to shape and deliver the team’s strategy. The role combines building reusable testing capabilities across Stripe with attention to the details that make developer tools effective and easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering planning and execution, partnering with Design to build clear, useful testing experiences.
  • Shape the team’s strategy and roadmap, aligning partners across Product, Design, Infrastructure, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Own delivery from problem definition through rollout and ongoing operation, improving both system performance and the user experience.
  • Uphold high engineering standards across the team’s codebases and development practices.
  • Partner with Recruiting to hire engineers and build a diverse, high-performing team.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, provide candid feedback, and support career development tailored to their goals.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply.

Minimum requirements

  • 4+ years of engineering management experience, directly managing and growing teams of 5+ engineers building and shipping products at scale.
  • 8+ years of full-time software development experience.
  • Experience building reusable, extensible software that supports a range of user needs, with strong user empathy and a commitment to high-quality user experiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of finding practical solutions to complex challenges.
  • Experience turning ambiguous goals into clear priorities and delivering multiple high-impact workstreams.
  • A track record of building a supportive environment with candid feedback and high expectations.
  • Technical depth to guide architecture and product design discussions and help engineers make informed tradeoffs.
  • Experience taking ownership of initiatives and moving work forward independently.

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong product and design judgment, including the ability to simplify complex user experiences.
  • Experience making decisions and building strong working relationships across teams.
  • Experience building and leading a distributed team across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Experience building developer tools or platform capabilities.
  • Experience building testing tools or capabilities that help users test within a product.
  • Experience building AI agent systems or tools that support agent-driven development.
descriptions.job-0x4fmih:
About Dune

Dune’s mission is to make onchain finance observable. We’re the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes and the Financial Times.

We’re a tight knit team of ~50 people across European and US Eastern time zones having an outsized impact on the industry. Our team brings experience from crypto natives to firms like Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Reuters and LSEG. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We’re backed by some of the world’s best investors. Our Series B in February 2022, led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join.

Learn more about us:

About Dune
https://dune.com/about

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Dune is building market data solutions for institutional customers who need timely, accurate and reliable financial data they can depend on. Our team turns onchain activity into realtime feeds and associated reference data along with historical data capture.

You will work on our new market data platform, and help shape how it evolves to support the growing features and customer base. You’ll design systems that can grow across chains, protocols and product capabilities while making clear decisions about correctness, latency, reliability, and cost.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will be expected to turn ambiguous requirements into designs and deliverable work, implement difficult parts yourself, and help other engineers own meaningful parts of the platform. AI-assisted development is a core part of how we expect you to work, paired with strong engineering judgment and ownership of what you ship.

In this role you will

  • Design and build distributed systems for ingestion, normalization, processing, storage, and delivery of realtime market data from blockchain and other relevant sources.

  • Build and operate streaming solutions that handle event ordering, timestamps, duplicates, replay, gaps, and recovery, including blockchain reorganizations and finality where they affect customer data.

  • Build reliable client feeds and APIs with clear delivery contracts, schema evolution, access controls, and predictable behavior under load or when consumers fall behind.

  • Partner with teams across Dune on reference data models and historical data capture.

  • Define and improve service objectives and data quality measures.

  • Instrument latency, freshness, completeness, and correctness, and turn incidents into lasting improvements in recovery and operations.

  • You will debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds.

  • Own services through deployment and production support, including participation in the team’s on-call rotation.

  • Use AI throughout development: explore designs, implement changes, build tests, investigate failures, and improve documentation. Develop repeatable workflows and share what works with the team.

  • Lead technical decisions across team boundaries, write clear designs, and mentor engineers through implementation and review.

You might be a great fit if

  • You have built and operated distributed backend or data services with demanding reliability and performance requirements. You understand their failure modes and can debug problems across service and data boundaries.

  • You have experience with realtime streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, and recovery. You care about data correctness, from timestamps and numeric precision to schema changes and corrections.

  • You have strong computer science fundamentals and backend engineering skills. Experience in Rust, Go or comparable languages is also valuable.

  • You turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production services, and help other engineers deliver parts of the solution.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a distributed team.

  • Financial or market data experience at a financial institution.

Not required but a plus

  • Onchain data experience: blockchain indexing such as with EVM or Solana.

  • Reference data experience: instrument and entity masters, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, or tokenized asset and fund data.

  • Experience at a company where the data is the product.



Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖

  • A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

  • We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).

  • On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
